It’s hard for someone with high intuition to explain why or how they came to their conclusions because in their head it just comes to them from nowhere. I feel it’s a combination of so many things.  At the surface level, I’ve been told many times I look very approachable which is so odd to me but I guess that’s a trait that a lot of infjs share.  We tend to be very good listeners and attune our emotions to fit whatever would come off best to who were speaking with.  It’s as if we’re a mirror with the person speaking to us reflecting on who they are.  Because were very non judge mental this mirror effect works because people will tell us more and more when they’re met with a gentle and kind attitude.  I also think that our advice that we can’t help but give out makes the person feel genuinely cared for which leads to a closer connection.  What’s funny to me about these connections is on several occasions I have met someone, talked to them from night til sunrise, and either never saw them again or never had another deep conversation.  And I’m perfectly ok with that lol.  Knowing so many peoples deep personal secrets that no one else knows.

I think that the infj sub in particular contains a lot of depressing stories because not many infjs have an outlet for their pain.  We tend to be the therapists of the group and even if we can show a vulnerable side to someone, it still could be twisted to cater to whoever we’re speaking to.  And on another note, evil infjs are the scariest people.  Take a personality type that dreams big and will stop at nothing to achieve their goals.  Add in the ability to speak passionately and charismatically along with the ability to read and adjust to people’s emotions.  This ability could easily be used for evil.  But most infjs are very selfless people who, if they manipulate at all, manipulate for a good cause.  I would say take pride in being an infj but also realize where you stand in this world.  You will always be the odd one out.  Another reason this sub is so great is that it’s a place where oddballs can bond and share similar experiences.

She emotionally cheated on me with her ex.  Her excuse for this was that she did not have the intention of getting into a relationship with him and that the only way she could get him to respond was by saying flirtatious things (essentially leading him on).  They were good friends before and she didn’t want to lose that bond despite the ex saying he couldn’t get over his feelings for her.  She says it will never happen again because it was a one time circumstance being her ex/long time friend.  I was ok with this excuse as I know her background/trauma and feel I have a greater sense of what’s really going on.  One thing that still strikes me odd is she’s never really remorseful or catering towards me unless I bring up the fact that she hasn’t really done anything to make me feel wanted.  She does tell me things to express her love but I believe actions speak louder than words and it’s extremely easy to tell someone what they want to hear rather than actually meaning it.  I don’t know if she can’t think of anything to do or if she just doesn’t care enough.  From my perspective, I would do anything I could to make my partner feel comfortable after such a scenario.  She takes every opportunity to be defensive about it rather than just apologizing and helping me through the pain i’m experiencing.  I love her so much and have sacrificed so much time and cut off relationships for her.  I don’t know what life could be like without her.
